description: Sourced material annotations for preset bodies (Stage 11, D-058, D-059). Only values with a fetched, citable source appear here. Anything absent is UNSUPPORTED for the models that need it (computed by the loader), never guessed. Annotations do not enter the integrator: they cannot change gravity. They are owner-accepted for development, NOT independently validated (D-059).

notFound.bodies-without-a-fetched-source: Sun, Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto, Titan, Rhea, Iapetus, Dione, Tethys: JPL SSD satellite physical-parameter page lists GM, mean radius and mean density only (no moment of inertia); no other source was fetched. Not guessed.
notFound.body-neptune: NASA Neptune fact sheet (neptunefact.html, 'Last Updated: 3 October 2024, DRW') has no moment-of-inertia row.
